label: Curie score
existing_definition: A semi-quantitative measure of metaiodobenzylguanidine uptake obtained by grading abnormal skeletal uptake across ten anatomical segments.

label: Derenzo phantom
existing_definition: A fillable nuclear medicine phantom containing multiple sets of parallel rods or holes of varying diameters arranged in pie-shaped sectors, used to evaluate the in-plane spatial resolution of tomographic systems.

label: area-based measurement
existing_definition: Any 2-dimensional spatial measurement of a region's area.

label: cardiac gated acquisition
existing_definition: An acquisition in which data are sorted into bins according to the phase of the heartbeat.

label: characteristic x-ray
existing_definition: Monoenergetic x-rays emitted when an outer-shell electron fills a vacancy in an inner electron shell.

label: circular orbit
existing_definition: A detector trajectory that maintains a constant radius about the axis of rotation.

label: clinical finding
existing_definition: A representation that is either the output of a clinical history taking or a physical examination or an image finding, or some combination thereof.

label: compactness
existing_definition: A measure of the ratio between the volume of a region of interest and a power of its bounding surface.

label: concavity
existing_definition: A measure of the extent to which the boundary of a region of interest is indented relative to its convex hull.

label: contrast
existing_definition: A measure of the local variation in gray-level values, emphasizing differences between neighboring pixels or voxels.

label: correlation
existing_definition: A measure of the linear dependence of gray levels of neighboring pixels or voxels.

label: detector configuration angle
existing_definition: The angle between two nuclear medicine detectors during acquisition.

label: detector material
existing_definition: A processed substance whose measurable response to incident radiation allows that radiation to be registered.

label: device component
existing_definition: A physical part manufactured to function within a larger piece of equipment.

label: eccentricity
existing_definition: A measure of the deviation of a region of interest from a circular or spherical shape.

label: elliptical orbit
existing_definition: A detector trajectory whose radius varies smoothly between two extremes along perpendicular axes.

label: elongation
existing_definition: A measure of the ratio between the second-largest and the largest principal axis length of a region of interest.

label: energy-compensated Geiger-Muller probe
existing_definition: A Geiger-Müller detector enclosed within a specific metallic filter designed to attenuate low-energy photons, correcting the inherent detector over-response to yield a uniform dose rate measurement across varying photon energies.

label: evaluation finding
existing_definition: A clinical observation produced by an intervention undertaken to assess a patient's state.

label: flatness
existing_definition: A measure of the ratio between the smallest and the largest principal axis length of a region of interest.

label: inorganic crystal scintillator
existing_definition: A crystalline substance of inorganic composition that emits light when ionizing radiation deposits energy within it.

label: intensity histogram feature
existing_definition: Any statistical metric derived directly from the intensity histogram of an image region, quantifying the distribution of voxel values without considering spatial relationships.

label: ionizing radiation
existing_definition: Radiation with enough energy to remove a bound electron from an atom and create an ion.

label: ionizing radiation detector material
existing_definition: A processed substance whose measurable response to ionizing radiation allows that radiation to be registered.

label: legs acquisition
existing_definition: The component of a two-part study that covers the lower extremities.

label: micro Derenzo phantom
existing_definition: A miniaturized version of the Derenzo phantom designed for evaluating the high spatial resolution of pre-clinical or small-animal PET and SPECT systems.

label: modified Curie score
existing_definition: A revision of the Curie score using altered segment definitions and grading criteria.

label: neutron survey meter
existing_definition: A polyethylene sphere with an internal borated layer attached to a ratemeter.

label: nuclear medicine detector spatial positioning
existing_definition: The placement and orientation of the detector relative to the patient and the axis of rotation.

label: nuclear medicine imaging procedure property
existing_definition: A property describing how an imaging study using an administered radiopharmaceutical is carried out.

label: observable entity
existing_definition: A quality, property, or characteristic that can be observed or measured.

label: open window
existing_definition: An energy window configuration accepting all events, regardless of energy.

label: organ volume
existing_definition: The total volume of an organ, as measured in an image.

label: organic crystal scintillator
existing_definition: A crystalline substance of organic composition that emits light when ionizing radiation deposits energy within it.

label: photon
existing_definition: The elementary quantum particle of electromagnetic radiation, having zero rest mass and traveling at the speed of light.

label: plantar mode
existing_definition: A detector configuration arranged to image the soles of the feet.

label: procedure related finding
existing_definition: A clinical observation arising in the course of, or as a consequence of, a medical procedure.

label: processed material
existing_definition: A substance that has been manufactured or refined for a particular purpose.

label: proportional counter
existing_definition: A gas-filled detector instrument operating at an intermediate voltage where primary ionization events trigger localized Townsend avalanches, generating an output signal proportional to the initial energy deposition.

label: proton emission
existing_definition: A particle emission decay in which a single proton is ejected.

label: qualifier value
existing_definition: A categorical modifier used to refine, constrain, or augment the conceptual meaning of a primary term.

label: relative activity measurement
existing_definition: Any radioactivity-based measurement in an image that has been normalized by a reference, such as administered activity.

label: respiratory gated acquisition
existing_definition: An acquisition in which data are sorted into bins according to the phase of breathing.

label: rotation direction
existing_definition: Whether the detector rotates clockwise or counterclockwise.

label: sphericity
existing_definition: A measure comparing the bounding surface of a sphere of equal volume with the bounding surface of a region of interest.

label: splenic infarct scan
existing_definition: A nuclear medicine spleen scan performed to identify a peripherally based focal defect of radiotracer uptake within the splenic parenchyma.

label: tissue ratio measurement
existing_definition: Any measurement of radioactivity in a region of interest that is normalized by the radioactivity measurement in another region.

label: x-ray
existing_definition: High-energy electromagnetic radiation originating from electron interactions or transitions outside the atomic nucleus, often in the energy range of 0.1-300 keV.
